ginning.title: About Cotton Ginning
ginning.subtitle: Ginning Outturn (GOT) & Parity Calculations
ginning.purpose: Accurately test Ginning Outturn (GOT) percentage from seed cotton (Kapas) and compute Cost of Production (Parity) as well as Reverse Buying Parity for profitable purchasing decisions.
howToUse: Select your calculation tab: Output (GOT test), Parity (Cost per Candy), or Reverse (Max purchase price).
Choose measurement unit: Sample (g) for 100g laboratory sample tests or Bulk (kg) for commercial mill lots.
Enter Raw Cotton (Kapas) weight along with Lint and Seed outputs to calculate GOT % and waste automatically.
In Parity / Reverse tabs, enter market rates (Kapas rate, Seed price, Ginning expense) to compute instant break-even costs.
keyFeatures: GOT Percentage Breakdown: Dynamic visual donut chart showing exact Lint %, Seed %, and Waste %.
Cost Parity Calculator: Computes net manufacturing cost for 1 Candy (355.62 kg) of lint after deducting seed revenue.
Reverse Buying Parity: Calculates the maximum price you can afford to pay per 20kg maund of Kapas to break even.
Real-Time Balance Check: Warns immediately if total output does not equal 100%.
importantFields: Total Raw Cotton (Kapas): Total unprocessed seed cotton weight tested or processed.
Lint Output: Weight of clean, ginned cotton fiber recovered.
Seed Output: Weight of cotton seed separated from fiber during ginning.
Waste / Loss: Trash, dust, and moisture loss during ginning process.
GOT % (Ginning Outturn): Percentage of lint fiber extracted from Kapas (typically 32% - 36%).
Kapas Purchase Rate: Market price paid per 20kg maund or 100kg quintal of seed cotton.
Seed Selling Price: Market realization per 20kg maund or 100kg quintal of cotton seed.
Ginning Expense: Electricity, labor, bale bagging, and processing charges per 20kg maund.
Shortage / Waste %: Expected invisible process loss and moisture loss during ginning.
Cost of Production (/ Candy): Total cost to produce one candy (355.62 kg) of lint factoring in seed sales and ginning charges.
Reverse Buying Parity: Highest purchase rate you can pay per 20kg maund to avoid losses at current market rates.
actions: Sample (g) / Bulk (kg) Toggle: Switch between gram lab testing and commercial kilogram lot processing.
Tab Navigation: Seamlessly switch between GOT Output, Cost Parity, and Reverse Parity calculations.
Unit Selection: Switch Kapas and Seed rates between 20kg Maund and 100kg Quintal.

oil.title: About Oil Mill
oil.subtitle: Seed Crushing Recovery, Profit & Khal Cost
oil.purpose: Track cottonseed crushing recovery (Wash Oil, Oil Cake, and Loss), calculate net crushing profit or loss, and determine the exact production cost of Khal (Oil Cake).
howToUse: Select your calculation tab: Recovery (Yield breakdown), Profit (Net P&L), or Khal Cost (Cost per unit).
Enter Total Seed Processed (kg), Wash Oil Recovery %, and Cake (Khal) %.
Review dynamic Output Breakdown cards for exact yields in kilograms and percentages.
In Profit & Khal Cost tabs, enter market rates (Seed purchase, Oil selling, Cake selling, and Processing expense) to view instant profitability.
keyFeatures: Dynamic Recovery Breakdown: Real-time calculation of Wash Oil (kg), Oil Cake (kg), and Waste/Moisture loss.
Crushing Profit/Loss Analysis: Automatically computes total revenue against total cost with clear profitability status.
Khal Production Cost: Computes exact manufacturing cost of Oil Cake across selectable unit sizes (50kg Bag, 20kg, 100kg, 1kg).
Visual Status Badges: Instant feedback indicating profitable or loss-making operations.
importantFields: Total Seed Processed: Total raw cottonseed fed into expellers/crushing plant.
Oil Rec. %: Percentage of unrefined Wash Oil extracted (typically 10% - 13%).
Cake (Khal) %: Percentage of solid protein cake produced (typically 82% - 86%).
Waste / Loss: Moisture evaporation and invisible process loss.
Seed Purchase Rate: Purchase price per 20kg maund, per ton, or per 100kg.
Oil Selling Rate: Market selling price of unrefined wash oil per 10kg, 1kg, or 15kg tin.
Cake (Khal) Selling Rate: Market selling price of oil cake per 50kg bag, 20kg, 100kg, or 1kg.
Processing Expense: Electricity, maintenance, labor, and steam expense per ton or per 20kg maund.
Net Crushing Profit / Loss: Total oil and cake realization minus total procurement and crushing cost per metric ton.
Khal Cost of Production: Net manufacturing cost to produce one unit of oil cake after deducting wash oil revenue.
actions: Tab Navigation: Switch between Recovery, Profit, and Khal Cost calculators.
Seed Buy Unit: Switch purchase unit between 20kg, 100kg, and Ton.
Oil Sell Unit: Switch oil selling unit between 10kg, 1kg, and 15kg tin.
Cake Sell Unit: Switch cake selling unit between 50kg Bag, 20kg, 100kg, and 1kg.
Show Cost Per Unit (Khal Cost): Choose display unit (50kg Bag, 20kg maund, 100kg quintal, 1kg).

settings.title: About Settings
settings.subtitle: Appearance, Language, PWA Installation & App Info
settings.purpose: Customize application appearance, switch languages instantly, install CottonCalc Pro as a standalone PWA app, share with peers, and view reference units and application details.
howToUse: In Appearance, tap System, Light, or Dark to change UI theme instantly.
In Language, tap English, हिन्दी, or ગુજરાતી to localize all calculations, labels, and help content.
In Application & Installation, click 'Install Application' to add to your Home Screen / Desktop.
In Share Application, tap 'Share Application' to send via WhatsApp, Telegram, or copy the direct link.
Review the About section for version details and standard commodity conversion factors.
Tap 'Reset Preferences' if you ever wish to restore default theme and language settings.
keyFeatures: Liquid Glass Themes: Seamless adaptation between ultra-crisp Light mode, OLED-optimized Dark mode, and System preference.
Multi-Language Support: Comprehensive localization for English, Hindi, and Gujarati with zero page reload.
Progressive Web App (PWA): Works completely offline with cached calculators and instant desktop/mobile app installation.
Native Sharing: Built-in share sheet integration to share with contacts and trade groups in 1 click.
One-Tap Refresh: Instantly refresh and sync latest application updates.
Preferences Persistence: Your selected language, theme, and units are automatically remembered across sessions.
importantFields: Appearance: Visual interface mode (System default, Light glass, Dark glass).
Language: UI language selection (English, Hindi, Gujarati).
App Status: Indicates whether running in Browser Mode or Installed Standalone PWA Mode.
Share Application: One-tap button to share CottonCalc Pro with business peers.
Standard Units: Official conversion standards (1 Candy = 355.62 kg Lint, 1 Maund = 20 kg, 1 Ton = 1000 kg).
actions: Theme Selection: Tap any theme tile to apply immediately.
Language Selection: Tap any language button to switch entire UI.
Install Application: Launch direct native app install prompt.
Share Application: Share app link via WhatsApp, SMS, or copy link.
Refresh Application: Refresh app to load fresh assets and latest updates.
Reset Preferences: Restore factory appearance and language defaults.
